analyst_view.overall: Early view: Burgos are third and have the best home record in the division by points (five wins, two draws, one defeat), with Sergio Francisco's side winning several games late. Cádiz are 20th and have not won away all season (two draws, three defeats), although Borja Jiménez's side created plenty in the 2-1 home defeat to Oviedo.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.3 goals. I lean slightly higher: Burgos' home games have averaged 2.6 goals and Cádiz's away games over three, and Cádiz are creating more chances under their new coach.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.0 corners. I lean higher: Burgos won 10 corners against Celta Fortuna at El Plantío and push a lot of players into the box, and Cádiz will spend long spells defending.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.9 cards. Burgos had one yellow against Celta Fortuna and Cádiz four against Oviedo; nothing points clearly away from the site's number.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.9 shots. I lean slightly higher: Burgos took 19 shots at home last time, and Cádiz had 15 against Oviedo, even if they will shoot less away.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.3 shots on target. Burgos had six on target against Celta Fortuna and Cádiz four against Oviedo, which fits the number.
